newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-SOTOMAYOR BOUNCES BACK AFTER DREADFUL YEAR.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SOTOMAYOR BOUNCES BACK AFTER DREADFUL YEAR.

text.p: Cuba's Javier Sotomayor bounced back after a dreadful 1996 on Wednesday to reclaim the world men's high jump title.
Sotomayor took the title with a leap of 2.37 then, with the gold medal already confirmed, took one abortive attempt at 2.41.
Poland's Artur Partyka, second behind Sotomayor four years ago, finished with the silver again followed by Australian Tim Forsyth.
Sotomayor. the world record holder with 2.45 metres, won the Olympic title in 1992 and the world title the following year.
He was hampered by knee, foot and ankle injuries in 1995 and again last year, finishing 11th at the Atlanta Olympics.
